title: Warm Indian Sweet Potato Kheer
description: A comforting and sweet Indian dessert featuring roasted sweet potatoes, this kheer is a unique twist on traditional recipes, with a hint of mustard and a smooth, molten texture, and is sugar-free-friendly by using natural sweeteners like honey or maple syrup.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the sweet potatoes with 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil and roast in the oven for 30 minutes, or until tender.
In a large saucepan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil over medium heat.
Add the mustard seeds and let them sizzle for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the ground cinnamon, ground cardamom, and salt, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the roasted sweet potatoes, honey or maple syrup, and milk to the saucepan.
Stir until the sweet potatoes are well coated with the spice mixture and the honey or maple syrup is dissolved.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the kheer has thickened slightly.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let the kheer cool to warm temperature.
